brief: A clean sans monospace for code: quiet and sturdy, readable for hours without being noticed. Clear 0/O and 1/l/I, distinct quotes and brackets, large punctuation. Must work at 12-15 px.

why.stem: 100 is slightly heavy, as the brief asks, and holds up on screen at 12-15 px.
why.thin: 84 keeps contrast low, so nothing thins out at small sizes.
why.x_height: 530 is large, for legibility at code sizes.
why.stress_deg: 0 is an upright axis: quieter and more engineered than the humanist sans.
why.advance: 600 is the conventional monospace width, about 0.6 em.
why.figures: Figures reach cap height so they read clearly in code; zero is dotted and one has a base.
